claim_ceiling: PROVENANCE_PARTIAL (not RESOLVED). Maximum justified: the uncommitted 3-definition analysis can be reconstructed from frozen raw evidence for DEF-FULL-MAP and DEF-FORM-ONLY within frozen tolerance (±0.001 density, identical orderings, identical C3 per definition: both match). ISOLATED-A-LINK in stored analysis_results.json is invalid (copy-paste of DEF-FULL-MAP, 7/7 tasks identical) and cannot be reproduced by a-only filtering; correct a-only analysis yields truncated ordering cart>detail>product_listing identical to full ordering (ordering_changed=False) vs stored ordering_changed=True. Therefore stored results are exploratory for ISOLATED-A-LINK and partially verified for other two. The directional finding that first-20 truncation changes page-type ordering (DEF-FULL-MAP cart>product_listing>detail -> cart>detail>product_listing; DEF-FORM-ONLY product_listing>cart>detail -> product_listing>detail>cart) is robust within this inflated DOM-count estimator, but point estimates remain invalid (total DOM counts conflated with locatable counts). Bounded to n=7 distinct tasks, 1 Magento site, truncated-first-20 vs tag-count-estimated full DOM, 1000-iteration DOM-proportional random baseline (seed 42). No inference to full DOM enumeration or cross-site.
